mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_POST) AS total_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_COMMENT) AS total_messages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_COMMENT WHERE comment_role = 'USER') AS user_messages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_COMMENT WHERE comment_role = 'ASSISTANT') AS assistant_messages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_POST WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()) AS today_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_COMMENT WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()) AS today_messages, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM CHAT_POST) AS unique_users

SELECT cp.chat_post_idx, cp.user_idx, cp.title, cp.created_at, u.user_id, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_COMMENT cc WHERE cc.chat_post_idx = cp.chat_post_idx) AS message_count, (SELECT MAX(cc.created_at) FROM CHAT_COMMENT cc WHERE cc.chat_post_idx = cp.chat_post_idx) AS last_message_at FROM CHAT_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = cp.user_idx
ORDER BY cp.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = cp.user_idx

SELECT cp.chat_post_idx, cp.user_idx, cp.title, cp.created_at, u.user_id, u.nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_COMMENT cc WHERE cc.chat_post_idx = cp.chat_post_idx) AS message_count, (SELECT MAX(cc.created_at) FROM CHAT_COMMENT cc WHERE cc.chat_post_idx = cp.chat_post_idx) AS last_message_at FROM CHAT_POST cp LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = cp.user_idx WHERE cp.chat_post_idx = #{chatPostIdx}

SELECT cc.chat_comment_idx, cc.chat_post_idx, cc.user_idx, cc.comment_role, cc.content, cc.comment_order, cc.created_at, u.nickname, cp.title AS session_title FROM CHAT_COMMENT cc LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = cc.user_idx LEFT JOIN CHAT_POST cp ON cp.chat_post_idx = cc.chat_post_idx WHERE cc.chat_post_idx = #{chatPostIdx} ORDER BY cc.comment_order ASC

SELECT cc.chat_comment_idx, cc.chat_post_idx, cc.user_idx, cc.comment_role, cc.content, cc.comment_order, cc.created_at, u.nickname, cp.title AS session_title FROM CHAT_COMMENT cc LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = cc.user_idx LEFT JOIN CHAT_POST cp ON cp.chat_post_idx = cc.chat_post_idx ORDER BY cc.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
